artifacts.synopsis: Rocky Mountain Presbytery erred in immediately deposing Rev. Bruce Nickoley for contumacy without giving him reasonable opportunity to defend himself under the due process provisions of the Book of Church Order. The case was remanded to the presbytery with recommendations to either institute a formal prosecution with due process or revoke the deposition and reinstate Nickoley.

artifacts.title: Nickoley v. Rocky Mountain
artifacts.synopsis: The SJC found that Rocky Mountain Presbytery erred in immediately deposing Rev. Bruce Nickoley from ministry on a contumacy charge without providing him due process rights and a full trial. The case was remanded for either proper trial or revocation of the deposition judgment.

artifacts.title: Steve Newton vs. Heartland Presbytery & Grace RPC Session vs. Heartland Presbytery
artifacts.synopsis: The Session of Grace Reformed Presbyterian Church appealed its conviction for contumacy and termination of its relationship with Heartland Presbytery. The SJC reversed the conviction, holding that a presbytery lacks original jurisdiction to indict and try a session (lower court) for an offense such as contumacy, as BCO provisions reserve original jurisdiction over ruling elders to the Session level.
